pilot_v1.fixed: unchanged personalities, commitment .5, purpose corridor .15, EventLearner 8/32/128; no case names in actor state
pilot_v1.scope: four finite public diagnostics; global deadline 4, late entry after 2 actual world steps; 6 successive contests
pilot_v1.comparisons: full terminal persona vs immediate utility; same start and paired random variates; each arm learns only its own public outcomes
pilot_v1.references: same-persona and purpose-optimal policies under referee probabilities; NEVER supplied to live actor; short finite graph ceiling, not human-level reference
pilot_v1.metrics: terminal win shares; objective opportunity losses; conditional personality/prediction gaps; illegal actions; ability/resource/entry paired choices; all adverse cases retained
pilot_v1.limits: fixed needs, no diplomacy or evolving personalities, known rules/capabilities; repeated profiles/seeds not independent game genres; learning omitted inside each solve
